title: scaphyglottis albida
intro: Scaphyglottis albida, commonly known as the White Scaphyglottis, is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. The White Scaphyglottis has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents.
